## 1. Veri Hazırlama ve Eğitim/Test Bölünmesi

```{r prepare-data}
data("Carseats", package = "ISLR", envir = environment())
df_carseats <- binarize_carseats_sales(Carseats, threshold = 8.0)
splits <- split_carseats_data(df_carseats, target_col = "Sales", train_ratio = 0.8, seed = 123L)
```

## 2. Naive Bayes Model Eğitimi ve Performans Metrikleri

```{r train-evaluate}
nb_fit <- train_carseats_naive_bayes(splits$train, splits$test, target_col = "Sales")
eval_res <- evaluate_binary_classifier(
  actual = nb_fit$actual,
  pred_class = nb_fit$pred_class,
  pred_prob = nb_fit$pred_prob[, "High"],
  positive_class = "High"
)

eval_res$confusion_table
eval_res$metrics
```

## 3. Confusion Matrix Isı Haritası ve ROC Eğrisi

```{r plots, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5}
plot_confusion_matrix_heatmap(eval_res$confusion_table)
plot_roc_curve(eval_res$roc_curve)
```
